The sea outside was calm, indifferent, offering no clue.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，发出低沉而均匀的呼吸。街灯依旧亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空无一人的柏油路上，倒映出潮湿的光泽。远处，几辆环卫车缓缓驶过，扫帚与地面摩擦的声音在寂静中格外清晰。早点铺的灯最先亮起，蒸笼里升腾的白雾弥漫到街角，带着面粉与葱花的气息。一只野猫从巷口闪过，消失在黑暗里。天际线处，最初的一抹灰蓝正悄然浮现，预示着又一个日出即将来临。这座城市即将醒来，而此刻的安宁，属于极少数目睹它的人。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Think of it like Russian nesting dolls: you open one and find a smaller one inside, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open — that's your base case, and then you put them all back together."}
